nodes.name: Run Pipeline (Stage 1)
nodes.notes: Runs discover→extract→merge→format_review, prints review to stdout. deal_id defaults to execution ID when missing to avoid collisions.

nodes.name: Send Review to Telegram
nodes.notes: Sends the formatted review message. Trimmed below Telegram's limit before the separate approval instructions message.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, text: 'Reply by POSTing to this resume URL with JSON like {"corrections":"ok"} or {"corrections":"fix: field value"}.\n\n' + $execution.resumeUrl }) }}

nodes.name: Send Approval Instructions
nodes.notes: Sends the resume URL separately so it is never truncated off the review message.

nodes.name: Wait for Confirm
nodes.notes: Pauses until resume URL is called with POST. Body: { "corrections": "ok" | "fix: field value" }. GET bypasses gate; POST required.

parameters.command: cd "{{ $env.CRE_ACQ_STAGE1 || '/path/to/cre-acquisitions-platform/stage-1-om-screener' }}" && CMD=".venv/bin/python3"; [ -x "$CMD" ] || CMD="python3"; CORRECTIONS="{{ ($json.body && $json.body.corrections) || $json.corrections || '' }}"; [ -n "$CORRECTIONS" ] || { echo 'Missing corrections in resume payload' >&2; exit 1; }; "$CMD" src/run_pipeline.py --confirm-only --deal-id "{{ $('Webhook Start').first().json.body.deal_id || $execution.id }}" --tmp-dir /tmp --corrections "$CORRECTIONS"

nodes.name: Run Pipeline (Confirm)
nodes.notes: Runs apply_corrections→score→format_output. Fails closed if corrections are missing from the POST body.

parameters.command: cd "{{ $env.CRE_ACQ_STAGE1 || '/path/to/cre-acquisitions-platform/stage-1-om-screener' }}" && python3 -c "import json; did='{{ $('Webhook Start').first().json.body.deal_id || $execution.id }}'; d=json.load(open('output/'+did+'.json')); verdict=d.get('verdict','UNKNOWN'); narrative=d.get('narrative','Screening complete.'); red_flags=d.get('red_flags', []); extra=(['', 'Red flags:'] + [f'- {flag.get(\"flag\", \"flag\")}: {flag.get(\"explanation\", \"\")}' for flag in red_flags[:5]]) if red_flags else []; message='\n'.join([f'Screening complete for {did}', f'Verdict: {verdict}', '', narrative] + extra); print(message[:3900])"

nodes.name: Build Verdict Message
nodes.notes: Builds a plain-text Telegram message with verdict, narrative, and up to five red flags, trimmed below Telegram's limit.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $env.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID, text: ($('Build Verdict Message').first().json.stdout || 'Screening complete.') }) }}

nodes.name: Send Verdict to Telegram
nodes.notes: Sends the plain-text verdict message to Telegram without Markdown parsing.
